s.t: A king lived in a castle.
s.fr: Un roi vivait dans un château.

s.t: He had six sons and one daughter.
s.fr: Il avait six fils et une fille.

s.t: The daughter was the youngest child.
s.fr: La fille était la plus jeune enfant.

s.t: The king's wife died many years ago.
s.fr: La femme du roi mourut il y a de nombreuses années.

s.t: The six brothers loved their sister.
s.fr: Les six frères aimaient leur sœur.

s.t: She loved her six brothers too.
s.fr: Elle aimait aussi ses six frères.

s.t: The brothers watched over her every day.
s.fr: Les frères veillaient sur elle chaque jour.

paras.summary: A king lives in a castle with his six sons and one daughter, the youngest child, and after his wife died many years ago, the siblings love and watch over one another every day.

s.t: The king missed his wife.
s.fr: Le roi regrettait sa femme.

s.t: The children grew up in the castle.
s.fr: Les enfants grandirent dans le château.

s.t: The king wanted a new wife.
s.fr: Le roi voulait une nouvelle femme.

s.t: He believed his children needed a mother.
s.fr: Il croyait que ses enfants avaient besoin d’une mère.

paras.summary: The king still misses his wife but has his children, and after many more years he wants a new wife, believing his children need a mother.

s.t: One day, the king rode into the forest.
s.fr: Un jour, le roi chevaucha dans la forêt.

s.t: He could not find his way to the castle.
s.fr: Il ne pouvait pas trouver son chemin vers le château.

s.t: The king rode on, but found no way.
s.fr: Le roi continua à cheval, mais ne trouva aucun chemin.

s.t: He grew afraid in the forest.
s.fr: Il eut peur dans la forêt.

s.t: He missed his children in the castle.
s.fr: Ses enfants au château lui manquaient.

s.t: He still loved his six sons and his daughter.
s.fr: Il aimait encore ses six fils et sa fille.

s.t: Night came, but he was still afraid.
s.fr: La nuit tomba, mais il avait encore peur.

paras.summary: One day the king rides into the forest and cannot find his way to the castle, and after he rides on, grows afraid, and misses his children, whom he still loves along with his six sons and daughter, night comes and he is still afraid when an old woman stands near him.

s.t: An old woman stood near the king.
s.fr: Une vieille femme se tenait près du roi.

s.t: "I know the way out of the forest," she said.
s.fr: « Je connais le chemin hors de la forêt, » dit-elle.

s.t: "I will lead you to the castle," said the old woman.
s.fr: « Je vous conduirai au château, » dit la vieille femme.

s.t: "But my daughter will become your wife," she said.
s.fr: « Mais ma fille deviendra votre femme, » dit-elle.

s.t: The king did not know the old woman.
s.fr: Le roi ne connaissait pas la vieille femme.

s.t: He wanted his children to have a mother.
s.fr: Il voulait que ses enfants aient une mère.

s.t: The king agreed.
s.fr: Le roi accepta.

s.t: The old woman led him to the castle.
s.fr: La vieille femme le conduisit au château.

paras.summary: The old woman offers to lead the king to the castle if her own daughter will become his wife, and though he does not know her, he wants his children to have a mother, so he agrees, and she leads him there.

s.t: The old woman's daughter became the king's wife.
s.fr: La fille de la vieille femme devint la femme du roi.

s.t: She became the new queen of the castle.
s.fr: Elle devint la nouvelle reine du château.

s.t: The queen never smiled at the six brothers.
s.fr: La reine ne sourit jamais aux six frères.

s.t: But the queen had a secret.
s.fr: Mais la reine avait un secret.

s.t: Her mother was a witch.
s.fr: Sa mère était une sorcière.

s.t: The queen knew magic too.
s.fr: La reine connaissait la magie aussi.

s.t: The queen did not love the six brothers.
s.fr: La reine n’aimait pas les six frères.

paras.summary: The old woman's daughter becomes the king's wife and the new queen of the castle, but she never smiles at the six brothers and has a secret, for her mother was a witch and the queen knows magic too.

s.t: She wanted the kingdom for her own children one day.
s.fr: Elle voulait le royaume pour ses propres enfants un jour.

s.t: The queen thought the six brothers were in her way.
s.fr: La reine pensait que les six frères étaient dans son chemin.

s.t: The king did not know his wife's secret.
s.fr: Le roi ne connaissait pas le secret de sa femme.

s.t: He believed his children now had a mother.
s.fr: Il croyait que ses enfants avaient maintenant une mère.

s.t: The king still loved his six sons.
s.fr: Le roi aimait encore ses six fils.

s.t: The six brothers did not know of her plan.
s.fr: Les six frères ne savaient pas son plan.

s.t: The sister did not know of it.
s.fr: La sœur ne le savait pas.

paras.summary: She wants the kingdom for her own children one day and thinks the six brothers are in her way, but the king does not know his wife's secret, believes his children now have a mother, and still loves his six sons, and neither the six brothers nor the sister know of her plan, so for a time the family lives on.

s.t: One day, the queen made a plan.
s.fr: Un jour, la reine fit un plan.

s.t: She took white silk out.
s.fr: Elle sortit de la soie blanche.

s.t: The queen sewed six little shirts of silk.
s.fr: La reine cousit six petites chemises de soie.

s.t: Each shirt held a secret charm.
s.fr: Chaque chemise contenait un charme secret.

s.t: The charm came from her mother's magic.
s.fr: Le charme venait de la magie de sa mère.

paras.summary: One day the queen makes a plan and takes out white silk to sew six little shirts, each holding a secret charm from her mother's magic.

s.t: She sewed the shirts in secret.
s.fr: Elle cousit les chemises en secret.

s.t: The queen waited for the six brothers.
s.fr: La reine attendit les six frères.

s.t: The king did not know of this.
s.fr: Le roi ne savait pas cela.

s.t: She wanted to find them alone.
s.fr: Elle voulait les trouver seuls.

s.t: The shirts were made in one night.
s.fr: Les chemises furent faites en une nuit.

s.t: The queen's plan could begin.
s.fr: Le plan de la reine pouvait commencer.

paras.summary: She sews the shirts in secret and keeps them hidden, and the queen waits to find the six brothers alone, though the king does not know of this, and once the shirts are ready in one night, her plan can begin.

s.t: The queen found the six brothers alone in the castle.
s.fr: La reine trouva les six frères seuls dans le château.

s.t: Their sister was not with them that day.
s.fr: Leur sœur n’était pas avec eux ce jour-là.

s.t: The queen took the six little shirts.
s.fr: La reine prit les six petites chemises.

s.t: She threw a shirt over each brother.
s.fr: Elle jeta une chemise sur chaque frère.

s.t: The magic charm began.
s.fr: Le charme magique commença.

s.t: Each brother became a white swan.
s.fr: Chaque frère devint un cygne blanc.

paras.summary: The queen finds the six brothers alone, while their sister is not with them, and she takes the six little shirts and throws one over each brother, and the magic charm begins to work, and each brother becomes a white swan.

s.t: The six swans flew up.
s.fr: Les six cygnes s’envolèrent.

s.t: They flew over the forest.
s.fr: Ils volèrent au-dessus de la forêt.

s.t: The sister watched from the castle.
s.fr: La sœur observait depuis le château.

s.t: She saw her six brothers become swans.
s.fr: Elle vit ses six frères devenir des cygnes.

s.t: The king did not know of this.
s.fr: Le roi ne savait pas cela.

s.t: The sister stood still.
s.fr: La sœur resta immobile.

s.t: She wanted to save her brothers.
s.fr: Elle voulait sauver ses frères.

paras.summary: The six swans fly up and over the forest while the sister watches from the castle, and she sees her six brothers become swans, though the king does not know of this; the sister stands still and wants to save her brothers.

s.t: The sister ran to find her father.
s.fr: La sœur courut pour trouver son père.

s.t: "My six brothers are swans now!" she said.
s.fr: « Mes six frères sont des cygnes maintenant ! » dit-elle.

s.t: The king could not believe her.
s.fr: Le roi ne pouvait pas la croire.

s.t: He did not know of the queen's plan.
s.fr: Il ne savait pas le plan de la reine.

s.t: The charm came from the queen's magic.
s.fr: Le charme venait de la magie de la reine.

s.t: The sister wanted to find her brothers.
s.fr: La sœur voulait trouver ses frères.

paras.summary: The sister runs to find her father and tells him her six brothers are swans now, but the king cannot believe her, for he did not know of the queen's plan, which came from the queen's own magic, and the sister wants to find her brothers, promising to save them.

s.t: "I will save them," she said.
s.fr: « Je les sauverai, » dit-elle.

s.t: The king did not want her to go.
s.fr: Le roi ne voulait pas qu’elle parte.

s.t: He was afraid for his daughter.
s.fr: Il avait peur pour sa fille.

s.t: But she was not afraid.
s.fr: Mais elle n’avait pas peur.

s.t: She left the castle alone.
s.fr: Elle quitta le château seule.

s.t: She walked into the forest.
s.fr: Elle marcha dans la forêt.

s.t: She grew tired, but did not turn back.
s.fr: Elle se fatigua, mais ne fit pas demi-tour.

s.t: The sister looked for the six swans.
s.fr: La sœur chercha les six cygnes.

s.t: She did not know where to find them.
s.fr: Elle ne savait pas où les trouver.

paras.summary: The king does not want her to go and is afraid for his daughter, but she is not afraid, so she leaves the castle alone and walks into the forest, growing tired, but she does not turn back, looking for the six swans though she does not know where to find them.

s.t: The sister walked on through the forest.
s.fr: La sœur continua à marcher dans la forêt.

s.t: Then she found a hut.
s.fr: Puis elle trouva une hutte.

s.t: White feathers lay near the hut.
s.fr: Des plumes blanches étaient posées près de la hutte.

s.t: The hut had six beds.
s.fr: La hutte avait six lits.

s.t: Six beds meant six brothers were near.
s.fr: Six lits signifiaient que six frères étaient proches.

s.t: The sister went inside the hut.
s.fr: La sœur entra dans la hutte.

paras.summary: The sister walks on through the forest until she finds a hut with white feathers lying near it, and inside are six beds, and six beds mean six brothers were near, for each bed was made for one brother, so the sister goes inside, far from the king's castle.

s.t: She was far from the king's castle.
s.fr: Elle était loin du château du roi.

s.t: She was still tired from her walk.
s.fr: Elle était encore fatiguée de sa marche.

s.t: The sister waited for her brothers.
s.fr: La sœur attendit ses frères.

s.t: Night came to the forest.
s.fr: La nuit vint dans la forêt.

s.t: She did not know when they would come.
s.fr: Elle ne savait pas quand ils viendraient.

paras.summary: She is still tired from her walk, and the sister waits for her brothers as night comes to the forest, not knowing when they would come.

s.t: At night, six swans flew to the hut in the forest.
s.fr: La nuit venue, six cygnes volèrent vers la hutte dans la forêt.

s.t: They flew near the sister.
s.fr: Ils volèrent près de la sœur.

s.t: Each swan became a brother again.
s.fr: Chaque cygne redevint un frère.

s.t: The six brothers stood near her.
s.fr: Les six frères se tinrent près d’elle.

s.t: "Our sister has come to find us!" one brother said.
s.fr: « Notre sœur est venue nous trouver ! » dit un frère.

s.t: The brothers ran to their sister.
s.fr: Les frères coururent vers leur sœur.

paras.summary: At night six swans fly to the hut in the forest and land near the sister, and each swan becomes a brother again, so the six brothers stand near her, and one brother says their sister has come to find them, and the brothers run to their sister.

s.t: "We can be human for fifteen minutes," said one brother.
s.fr: « Nous pouvons être humains pendant quinze minutes, » dit un frère.

s.t: "Then we become swans again," he said.
s.fr: « Ensuite nous redevenons des cygnes, » dit-il.

s.t: The sister cried, for she had found her six brothers.
s.fr: La sœur pleura, car elle avait trouvé ses six frères.

s.t: They still loved their father the king.
s.fr: Ils aimaient encore leur père le roi.

s.t: But she knew they had little time.
s.fr: Mais elle savait qu’ils avaient peu de temps.

paras.summary: One brother explains they can be human for fifteen minutes before they become swans again, and the sister cries, for she has found her six brothers, who still love their father the king, but she knows they have little time.

s.t: "You must free us from the charm," said one brother.
s.fr: « Vous devez nous libérer du charme, » dit un frère.

s.t: "There is one way," he said.
s.fr: « Il y a une façon, » dit-il.

s.t: "You must sew six shirts of starwort," said another brother.
s.fr: « Tu dois coudre six chemises de stellaire, » dit un autre frère.

s.t: "This will take six years," he said.
s.fr: « Cela prendra six ans, » dit-il.

s.t: "You must not speak for six years," said one brother.
s.fr: « Tu ne dois pas parler pendant six ans, » dit un frère.

s.t: "You must not laugh," he said.
s.fr: « Tu ne dois pas rire, » dit-il.

paras.summary: One brother tells the sister she must free them from the charm by sewing six shirts of starwort, a task that will take six years, during which she must not speak, and another brother adds she must not laugh.

s.t: "If you speak, we stay swans forever," said another brother.
s.fr: « Si tu parles, nous restons cygnes pour toujours, » dit un autre frère.

s.t: But the sister was not afraid.
s.fr: Mais la sœur n’avait pas peur.

s.t: "I will do this for you," she said.
s.fr: « Je ferai cela pour vous, » dit-elle.

s.t: The six brothers thanked their sister.
s.fr: Les six frères remercièrent leur sœur.

s.t: They were far from the castle now.
s.fr: Ils étaient loin du château maintenant.

s.t: She missed her father the king.
s.fr: Elle regrettait son père le roi.

paras.summary: A third warning says that if she speaks, they will stay swans forever, but she is not afraid and promises to do this for them, so the six brothers thank their sister, far from the castle now, and she misses her father the king.

s.t: The sister began to gather starwort.
s.fr: La sœur commença à cueillir de la stellaire.

s.t: She said nothing, as the brothers had said.
s.fr: Elle ne dit rien, comme les frères l’avaient dit.

s.t: Every day, she gathered more starwort.
s.fr: Chaque jour, elle cueillit davantage d’stellaire.

s.t: Every night, she sewed the starwort into shirts.
s.fr: Chaque nuit, elle cousit la stellaire en chemises.

s.t: She climbed a tree to sleep.
s.fr: Elle grimpa dans un arbre pour dormir.

s.t: The tree kept her hidden.
s.fr: L’arbre la garda cachée.

paras.summary: The sister begins to gather starwort and says nothing, as the brothers had said, gathering more starwort every day and sewing it into shirts every night, and she climbs a tree to sleep, hidden there.

s.t: She did not speak or laugh.
s.fr: Elle ne parla ni ne rit.

s.t: Six years would pass this way.
s.fr: Six ans passeraient ainsi.

s.t: The sister worked on, silent and alone.
s.fr: La sœur continua à travailler, silencieuse et seule.

s.t: She would free her six brothers.
s.fr: Elle libérerait ses six frères.

paras.summary: She does not speak or laugh, for six years would pass this way, and the sister works on, silent and alone, for she would free her six brothers.

s.t: A young king rode through the forest.
s.fr: Un jeune roi traversa la forêt à cheval.

s.t: He saw a girl asleep in a tree.
s.fr: Il vit une fille endormie dans un arbre.

s.t: She held starwort and shirts in her arms.
s.fr: Elle tenait de la stellaire et des chemises dans ses bras.

s.t: The young king asked her name, but she said nothing.
s.fr: Le jeune roi lui demanda son nom, mais elle ne dit rien.

s.t: She could not speak, for six years remained.
s.fr: Elle ne pouvait pas parler, car il restait six ans.

s.t: She missed her six brothers.
s.fr: Elle regrettait ses six frères.

paras.summary: A young king rides through the forest and sees a girl asleep in a tree, holding starwort and shirts in her arms, and though the young king asks her name, she says nothing and he does not know it, for she cannot speak while six years remain, and she misses her six brothers.

s.t: The young king wanted to help the silent girl.
s.fr: Le jeune roi voulait aider la fille silencieuse.

s.t: He brought her down from the tree.
s.fr: Il la fit descendre de l’arbre.

s.t: The young king took her to his castle.
s.fr: Le jeune roi l’emmena à son château.

s.t: She brought her starwort and shirts too.
s.fr: Elle lui apporta aussi de la stellaire et des chemises.

s.t: The young king wanted her to become his wife.
s.fr: Le jeune roi voulait qu’elle devienne sa femme.

paras.summary: The young king wants to help the silent girl, so he brings her down from the tree and takes her to his castle, where she brings her starwort and shirts too, and the young king wants her to become his wife.

s.t: Soon the young king married the silent girl.
s.fr: Bientôt le jeune roi épousa la fille silencieuse.

s.t: She became the young queen, though she could not speak.
s.fr: Elle devint la jeune reine, bien qu’elle ne pût pas parler.

s.t: The young king had a mother.
s.fr: Le jeune roi avait une mère.

s.t: She was an old queen.
s.fr: C’était une vieille reine.

s.t: The old queen did not like the silent wife.
s.fr: La vieille reine n’aimait pas la femme silencieuse.

paras.summary: Soon the young king marries the silent girl, and she becomes the young queen, though she cannot speak, but the young king has a mother, an old queen, who does not like the silent wife.

s.t: "She cannot even speak!" said the old queen.
s.fr: « Elle ne peut même pas parler ! » dit la vieille reine.

s.t: No one knew where the silent girl came from.
s.fr: Personne ne savait d’où venait la fille silencieuse.

s.t: The old queen thought the girl was a witch.
s.fr: La vieille reine pensait que la fille était une sorcière.

s.t: The old queen did not trust her.
s.fr: La vieille reine ne lui faisait pas confiance.

paras.summary: "She cannot even speak!" says the old queen, for no one knows where the silent girl came from, and the old queen thinks she is a witch and does not trust her.

s.t: But the young king loved her.
s.fr: Mais le jeune roi l’aimait.

s.t: He would not listen to his mother.
s.fr: Il ne voulait pas écouter sa mère.

s.t: The old queen began to make a plan.
s.fr: La vieille reine commença à faire un plan.

s.t: The young queen still had her starwort shirts.
s.fr: La jeune reine avait encore ses chemises de stellaire.

s.t: She sewed on in secret.
s.fr: Elle continua à coudre en secret.

paras.summary: But the young king loves her and will not listen to his mother, so the old queen begins to make a plan, while the young queen, who still has her starwort shirts, sews on in secret.

s.t: Time passed, and the young queen sewed on.
s.fr: Le temps passa, et la jeune reine continua à coudre.

s.t: Soon the young queen had a baby.
s.fr: Bientôt la jeune reine eut un bébé.

s.t: The baby was a boy.
s.fr: Le bébé était un garçon.

s.t: The young king was happy.
s.fr: Le jeune roi était heureux.

s.t: But the old queen still had her plan.
s.fr: Mais la vieille reine avait encore son plan.

s.t: One night, the young queen slept deeply.
s.fr: Une nuit, la jeune reine dormit profondément.

paras.summary: Time passes, and the young queen sews on until soon she has a baby, a boy, and the young king is happy, but the old queen still has her plan, and one night the young queen sleeps deeply.

s.t: The old queen took the baby away.
s.fr: La vieille reine emmena le bébé.

s.t: She hid the baby where no one could find him.
s.fr: Elle cacha le bébé là où personne ne pouvait le trouver.

s.t: The old queen put blood on the sleeping queen.
s.fr: La vieille reine mit du sang sur la reine endormie.

s.t: "The young queen killed her own baby!" said the old queen.
s.fr: « La jeune reine a tué son propre bébé ! » dit la vieille reine.

s.t: The young king did not want to believe this.
s.fr: Le jeune roi ne voulait pas croire cela.

s.t: He still loved his silent queen.
s.fr: Il aimait encore sa reine silencieuse.

paras.summary: The old queen takes the baby away and hides him where no one could find him, then puts blood on the sleeping young queen and says she killed her own baby, but the young king does not want to believe this, for he still loves his silent queen.

s.t: The old queen told the whole castle.
s.fr: La vieille reine dit cela à tout le château.

s.t: "Everyone must know the truth!" she said.
s.fr: « Tout le monde doit connaître la vérité ! » dit-elle.

s.t: Everyone believed the old queen.
s.fr: Tout le monde crut la vieille reine.

s.t: They wanted the young queen punished.
s.fr: Ils voulaient que la jeune reine soit punie.

s.t: The young king still did not believe it.
s.fr: Le jeune roi ne le crut toujours pas.

paras.summary: The old queen tells the whole castle that everyone must know the truth, and everyone believes the old queen and wants the young queen punished, but the young king still does not believe it.

s.t: The king's council came to the castle.
s.fr: Le conseil du roi vint au château.

s.t: They said the young queen must be punished.
s.fr: Ils dirent que la jeune reine devait être punie.

s.t: The young king wanted them to wait.
s.fr: Le jeune roi voulait qu’ils attendent.

s.t: But the council would not listen to him.
s.fr: Mais le conseil ne voulut pas l’écouter.

paras.summary: The king's council comes to the castle and says the young queen must be punished, and the young king wants them to wait, but the council will not listen to him.

s.t: They chose a day for the fire.
s.fr: Ils choisirent un jour pour le feu.

s.t: That day would be the last day of her six years.
s.fr: Ce jour serait le dernier jour de ses six ans.

s.t: The young queen could not speak to save herself.
s.fr: La jeune reine ne pouvait pas parler pour se sauver.

s.t: She thought of her brothers, far away.
s.fr: Elle pensa à ses frères, loin d’elle.

s.t: She was condemned to die in the fire.
s.fr: Elle fut condamnée à mourir dans le feu.

paras.summary: They choose a day for the fire, the last day of her six years, and the young queen cannot speak to save herself; she thinks of her brothers, far away, and is condemned to die in the fire.

s.t: The day of the fire came at last.
s.fr: Le jour du feu arriva enfin.

s.t: Guards led the young queen out.
s.fr: Des gardes conduisirent la jeune reine dehors.

s.t: She still had one shirt to finish.
s.fr: Elle avait encore une chemise à finir.

s.t: It was the sixth shirt, for the youngest brother.
s.fr: C’était la sixième chemise, pour le frère le plus jeune.

s.t: She sewed as she walked to the fire.
s.fr: Elle cousait pendant qu’elle marchait vers le feu.

paras.summary: The day of the fire comes at last, and guards lead the young queen out, but she still has one shirt to finish, the sixth, for the youngest brother, so she sews as she walks to the fire.

s.t: One sleeve was not yet done.
s.fr: Une manche n’était pas encore terminée.

s.t: There was no time to finish it.
s.fr: Il n’y avait pas de temps pour la finir.

s.t: The young king watched, but could not help her.
s.fr: Le jeune roi regardait, mais ne pouvait pas l’aider.

s.t: The people gathered to watch her die.
s.fr: Les gens se rassemblèrent pour la regarder mourir.

s.t: The old queen smiled at this.
s.fr: La vieille reine sourit à cela.

paras.summary: One sleeve is not yet done, and there is no time to finish it, so the young king watches but cannot help her, while the people gather to watch her die, and the old queen smiles at this.

s.t: Six swans flew over the fire.
s.fr: Six cygnes volèrent au-dessus du feu.

s.t: The swans flew near the young queen.
s.fr: Les cygnes volèrent près de la jeune reine.

s.t: The young queen threw the six shirts over them.
s.fr: La jeune reine lança les six chemises sur eux.

s.t: Everyone saw the six brothers appear.
s.fr: Tout le monde vit les six frères apparaître.

s.t: But the sixth shirt had no left sleeve.
s.fr: Mais la sixième chemise n’avait pas de manche gauche.

paras.summary: Six swans fly over the fire and near the young queen, and the young queen throws the six shirts over them, so everyone sees the six brothers appear and stand near her again, but the sixth shirt had no left sleeve.

s.t: The youngest brother still had one swan wing.
s.fr: Le frère cadet avait encore une aile de cygne.

s.t: His arm was a wing, not a hand.
s.fr: Son bras était une aile, pas une main.

s.t: But he was still her brother.
s.fr: Mais il était quand-même son frère.

s.t: The young king stopped the fire at once.
s.fr: Le jeune roi arrêta le feu aussitôt.

s.t: He ran to his silent wife.
s.fr: Il courut vers sa femme silencieuse.

s.t: The six brothers were free at last.
s.fr: Les six frères étaient enfin libres.

paras.summary: The youngest brother still has one swan wing, for his arm is a wing, not a hand, but he is still her brother, and the young king stops the fire at once and runs to his silent wife, for the six brothers are free at last and the charm is broken forever.

s.t: The young queen could speak again.
s.fr: La jeune reine pouvait parler de nouveau.

s.t: "I can speak now!" she said.
s.fr: « Je peux parler maintenant ! » dit-elle.

s.t: She told everyone the truth.
s.fr: Elle dit la vérité à tout le monde.

s.t: She told of the charm and six silent years.
s.fr: Elle parla du charme et des six années silencieuses.

s.t: The six brothers said this too.
s.fr: Les six frères dirent cela aussi.

s.t: Everyone believed them now.
s.fr: Tout le monde les crut maintenant.

paras.summary: The young queen can speak again and says she can speak now, so she tells everyone the truth, of the charm and six silent years, and the six brothers say this too, so everyone believes them now.

s.t: The old queen turned pale.
s.fr: La vieille reine devint pâle.

s.t: She could not deny the truth.
s.fr: Elle ne pouvait pas nier la vérité.

s.t: The old queen had lied to everyone.
s.fr: La vieille reine avait menti à tout le monde.

s.t: She had taken the baby herself.
s.fr: Elle avait elle-même pris le bébé.

s.t: The young king grew angry.
s.fr: Le jeune roi devint furieux.

s.t: "You have done a terrible thing," he said.
s.fr: « Vous avez fait une chose terrible, » dit-il.

paras.summary: The old queen turns pale and cannot deny the truth, for the old queen had lied to everyone and had taken the baby herself, so the young king grows angry and says she has done a terrible thing.

s.t: The old queen had to lead them to the baby.
s.fr: La vieille reine devait les conduire jusqu’au bébé.

s.t: She had hidden him nearby.
s.fr: Elle l’avait caché près d’ici.

s.t: They found the baby safe and well.
s.fr: Ils trouvèrent le bébé sain et sauf.

s.t: Then the young king banished the old queen.
s.fr: Alors le jeune roi bannit la vieille reine.

s.t: She had to leave the castle forever.
s.fr: Elle dut quitter le château pour toujours.

s.t: No one saw the old queen again.
s.fr: Personne ne revit la vieille reine.

paras.summary: The old queen has to lead them to the baby, whom she had hidden nearby, and they find him safe and well; then the young king banishes the old queen, who must leave the castle forever, and no one sees her again.

s.t: The young queen held her baby again.
s.fr: La jeune reine tint de nouveau son bébé.

s.t: The six brothers lived in the castle too.
s.fr: Les six frères vivaient aussi dans le château.

s.t: The young king and queen ruled well together.
s.fr: Le jeune roi et la reine gouvernèrent bien ensemble.

s.t: The youngest brother still had his swan wing.
s.fr: Le frère cadet avait encore son aile de cygne.

s.t: But everyone still loved him.
s.fr: Mais tout le monde l’aimait encore.

s.t: They all lived well for many years.
s.fr: Ils vécurent tous bien pendant de nombreuses années.

paras.summary: The young queen holds her baby again, and the six brothers live in the castle too, while the young king and queen rule well together; the youngest brother still has his swan wing, but everyone still loves him, and they all live well for many years.
